description:
## Summary

Jest CLI currently prints a warning that tests have probably left handles open if it does not exit cleanly after 1000 millseconds.

This makes that timeout customisable, with the ability to disable it completely.

Useful when invoking `jest-cli` programmatically and doing work after the test run, or in other cases where handles may be known to be slower to close.

## Test plan
 - New e2e test covering CLI option
 - Tested locally patched at FB (`openHandlesTimeout` specified via config file)

Is this CLI only option? I think it should be added only to `Argv` type below. Good example could be `runInBand`.

`InitialOptions` is exported as `Config` from `'jest'` package. This type users can use for `jest.config.js` default export.

https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/68e702526c1489abc669ddb2f6364f880848bd77/packages/jest/src/index.ts#L19

Ah.. It can be used in config file too. In this case it would be good to document it in this file too: https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/main/docs/Configuration.md

And to work was CLI option it should be added here: https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/68e702526c1489abc669ddb2f6364f880848bd77/packages/jest-cli/src/args.ts#L244-L249
Move it below Modes please. These belong to `notifyMode `.
